svg.text: Bin Wall components · sheet 1 of 2: colours and feedback
Real UI size · synthetic demo data · plan “Spring re-slot 2026”, data as of 2026-09-30

text.tspan: · FR-42 · opened from the Slow-moving entry of the Key; the wall behind changes live
· bottom-left, one at a time, at least 10 s (longer for long text), paused on hover or focus; Undo only on an applied-move toast

svg.text: Best-location marks changed · 3 recommendations are now outdated
Undo reverses them one move at a time.
“No space” parts and kept parts are skipped.
The plan, its marks, moves and recommendations
are deleted for everyone. There is no archive.
The import stays: 1 other plan uses it.

text.tspan: · launcher SET or the plan overview; read-only analysis settings (FR-18)

g.text: Spring re-slot 2026 was computed with these settings.
They are changed in the configuration file, not in the app.
